Dad's Chicken Noodle Soup

.cook
👥 8 servings ⏱️ Prep Time: 30 minutes 🔥 Cook Time: 1 hour 📖 Dad

🥘 Ingredients

  • carrots (diced)
    4
  • celery stalks (diced)
    3
  • fresh poultry herbs
    1 package
  • mini farfalle pasta
    3/4 box
  • old bay seasoning
  • onion (diced)
    1 medium
  • pepper
  • red bell pepper (julienne cut)
    1
  • rotisserie chicken
    1
  • salt
  • vegetable oil
    1 tbsp

🍳 Cookware

  • stock pot
  1. 1
    Prepare the stock pot . With a small amount of vegetable oil , saute about half the onion in the bottom of the pot until it just starts to turn translucent and soften. Set aside until the chicken is ready.
    vegetable oil: 1 tbsp, onion: 1 medium (diced)
  2. 2
    Break down the rotisserie chicken with your hands into about 8-12 pieces. Add the chicken, as well as any extra chicken skin or jelly from the bag, to the pot.
    rotisserie chicken: 1
  3. 3
    In the stockpot, cover the chicken with water, normally about 3-4 quarts.
  4. 4
    Chop the fresh poultry herbs and place in either a large tea ball or cheesecloth wrap. Add to stockpot.
    fresh poultry herbs: 1 package
  5. 5
    Boil the chicken and herb bundle for ⏱️ 45-55 minutes . The chicken meat should separate from the bone very easily.
  6. 6
    Let cool and strain all the stock through a sieve into a separate bowl or pot.
  7. 7
    Pick out any inedible chicken parts with your hands.
  8. 8
    Combine the edible parts of the chicken with carrots , celery stalks , remaining onion, and the herb bundle with the stock back into an empty pot.
    carrots: 4 (diced), celery stalks: 3 (diced)
  9. 9
    Bring to a boil again and simmer for ⏱️ 30 minutes , tasting and seasoning with salt , pepper , and old bay seasoning to taste.
    salt, pepper, old bay seasoning
  10. 10
    Add red bell pepper and mini farfalle pasta . Simmer for another ⏱️ 20 minutes , tasting again and seasoning as needed.
    red bell pepper: 1 (julienne cut), mini farfalle pasta: 3/4 box
  11. 11
    Serve, often with shredded cheese and a dinner roll.
  12. 📝

    The noodles will continue to absorb broth over time. Leftovers become a very hearty chicken noodle stew. The soup reaches peak flavor the day after it was made.
